author: Sandilya, S. and others
title: Search for the Rare Decay $B^0 \to K^{*0} e^\pm \mu^\mp$
abstract: We report a search for the lepton flavor violating decays $B^0 \to K^{*0} e^\pm \mu^\mp$ using a data sample of 711 fb$^{-1}$ collected at the $\Upsilon(4S)$ resonance with the Belle detector at the KEKB asymmetric-energy $e^+ e^-$ collider. We find no evidence for the decays and set upper limits on the branching fractions.
